
```{r}
library(lme4)

set.seed(123)

n_subjects <- 26
n_sim <- 200

p_low <- 0.50
p_high <- 0.70

significant <- rep(FALSE, n_sim)

for (i in 1:n_sim) {
  subject <- rep(1:n_subjects, each = 8)
  end_sequence <- rep(c("low", "high"), each = 4, times = n_subjects)
  subject_bias <- rnorm(n_subjects, mean = 0, sd = 0.7)
  
  probability <- ifelse(
    end_sequence == "low",
    plogis(qlogis(p_low) + subject_bias[subject]),
    plogis(qlogis(p_high) + subject_bias[subject])
  )
  
  purchase <- rbinom(
    n = length(probability),
    size = 1,
    prob = probability
  )
  
  data <- data.frame(
    subject = subject,
    end_sequence = end_sequence,
    purchase = purchase
  )
  
  data$end_sequence <- factor(data$end_sequence, levels = c("low", "high"))
  
  model <- suppressWarnings(
    suppressMessages(
      glmer(
        purchase ~ end_sequence + (1 | subject),
        data = data,
        family = binomial
      )
    )
  )
  
  p_value <- summary(model)$coefficients["end_sequencehigh", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  significant[i] <- p_value < 0.05
}

mean(significant)
```
